description: This file implements functions for handling registry-controlled domains, including extracting domain and registry parts, checking for registry-controlled domains, and managing domain graph data structures. It is part of the Chromium project's network domain handling.

classes.name: MappedHostComponent
classes.description: Structure representing host component positions for canonicalization and registry extraction.

methods.name: GetRegistryLengthInTrimmedHost
methods.description: Determines the length of the registry part in a trimmed host, considering rules and exceptions.

methods.name: GetRegistryLengthImpl
methods.description: Calculates the length of the registry-controlled domain within a host, handling dots and special rules.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistryImpl
methods.description: Extracts the domain and registry part from a host string.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistryAsStringPiece
methods.description: Returns a StringPiece referencing the domain and registry part of a host, or empty if invalid.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistry
methods.description: Overloaded functions to get domain and registry from GURL, url::Origin, or StringPiece.

methods.name: SameDomainOrHost
methods.description: Checks if two hosts or origins are in the same domain or host.

methods.name: GetRegistryLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the registry-controlled domain in a URL.

methods.name: HostHasRegistryControlledDomain
methods.description: Determines if a host has a registry-controlled domain.

methods.name: GetCanonicalHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Gets the registry length for a canonical host string.

methods.name: PermissiveGetHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Calculates registry length with permissive rules, handling UTF-8 and UTF-16 inputs.

methods.name: ResetFindDomainGraphForTesting
methods.description: Resets the domain graph to default for testing.

methods.name: SetFindDomainGraphForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom domain graph for testing purposes.
